items.title: 5.4 Enzyme ke kaam ki raftar par asar dalne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4, printed pages 131-133.

blocks.text: Enzymes jis mahol (environment) mein kaam karte hain us ke liye bohat hassas (sensitive) hote hain. Har woh tabdeeli jo enzyme ki chemistry ya us ki teen-dimensional shakal badal de, us ki sargarmi (activity) par asar dalti hai. Enzyme ke kaam ki raftar par asar dalne wale kuch awamil (factors) aage bayan kiye ja rahe hain.
